comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
New buildable colony building 'Food Storehouse' that can increase a number of trade goods at foodstuff market in colony. Requires Wood 70 + Stone 30 + 500.000 Ducats.

Unless the translation was misinterpreted, it is said that you can build the same type of storehouse up to 3 in colony, but we will see, the update is just one week away
